name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Primary Fast-layer candidate for routine chat, editing, and agent loops on one NVIDIA GB10.
limitations: The official BF16 checkpoint measured 2.15 decode tok/s and 24.3 s warm TTFT on the first complete-checkpoint probe, so the promotion candidate uses conversion-time NVFP4 routed experts.

The version 0.3.0 NVFP4 deployment earned Frontier certification at 12.51 decode tok/s, but version 0.4.0 targets Fast and remains Preview until it reaches 20 tok/s with no normal-operation NVMe stalls.
The version 0.3.0 Frontier evidence scored 3/5 on the five-problem AIME sample; two requests exhausted the 2048-token reasoning budget before emitting a final answer.
QSA selection currently runs eagerly, so CUDA graph capture is disabled.
The published checkpoint is multimodal; initial Spark Lab certification is text-only.
The version 0.3.0 Frontier endurance run added no swap, but unrelated host processes already occupied swap; sparklab plan/run still require a zero-swap platform preflight.
